extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and administrative staff preparing NIH PHS-398 style grant applications (e.g., SBIR applicants, PIs and key personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Complete the PHS 398-style biographical sketch and Research & Related budget (sections A–K) for an NIH grant application, including required fields for key personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirect costs, fee, and a single-file budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the key personnel in the order listed for Form Page 2. Follow the sample format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required fields (as shown): NAME; POSITION TITLE; eRA COMMONS USER NAME; EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, and include postdoctoral training.); INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); YEAR(s); FIELD OF STUDY. Include sections A (Personal Statement), B (Positions and Honors), and C (Representative Peer-Reviewed Publications). Follow sample formatting and page limit strictly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Personal Statement (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement: a concise statement of the major emphasis of the applicant's research and how it relates to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize research focus, relevance to the proposal, key expertise (e.g., techniques, approaches), and role on the project. Keep within the biosketch page limit and follow the sample content/ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Positions and Honors (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors: list professional positions (chronological) and honors/awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and institution/position titles. Show relevant progression of responsibilities and recognition that support the individual's qualifications for the proposed role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch: Representative Publications (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Representative Peer-Reviewed Publications (select recent examples from full publication record).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List recent/most relevant peer-reviewed publications (the example lists 'Representative Peer-Reviewed Publications (2009-2012) from a total of 153'). Choose items that best demonstrate expertise relevant to the proposed work; adhere to space/page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section A & B — Senior/Key Person salary and effort
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION A & B, BUDGET PERIOD: For each Senior/Key Person include Project Role, Base Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($), Academic Months, Calendar Months, Number of Personnel, and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-person requested salary and percent effort (academic and calendar months), fringe benefit dollars, and compute totals for all Senior/Key Persons. Include 'Total Funds requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file' and total salary, wages and fringe benefits for A+B.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section C — Equipment threshold and listing
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each equipment item > $5,000 provide item description and funds requested. Provide a subtotal: 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section D — Travel categorization and totals
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel: Separate Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs; provide line-item amounts and compute Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize travel by traveler/role where appropriate (e.g., PI or Staff Scientist), include registration and travel breakdown, and sum domestic + foreign travel to total travel cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section E — Participant/Trainee Support costs
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs: include Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; Stipends; Travel; Subsistence; Other; Number of Participants/Trainees; and Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts of participants/trainees and dollar amounts per category; report totals for participant support separately from other direct costs as required by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Section F — Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs: itemize Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; etc., and compute Total Other Direct Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out major material categories (e.g., plasticware, reagents, cell lines, antibodies) and provide year-by-year breakdown where applicable. Include facility/user fees justification (e.g., EM sessions) as part of justification attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget totals and indirect costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct Costs (G = A through F), Indirect Costs (H) with Indirect Cost Rate (%) and Indirect Cost Base ($), and compute I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs (G + H). Include Cognizant Federal Agency information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the F&A rate used, show its application to the base, and include contact/agency for cognizant federal negotiations. Ensure totals are internally consistent and match amounts in budget justification and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Fee (profit) line item
rubrics_metrics.description: J. Fee: include fee as a dollar amount or percentage (e.g., 'TechnoVax requests 6.99% fixed fee').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If allowed (e.g., SBIR), state the fixed fee percentage and provide brief justification linking fee to allowable company reinvestment or operating costs, and include it in Total Direct and Indirect Costs as required by the program instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification: single-file attachment and required content
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification (attach one file): provide narrative justification for personnel, fringe benefits, salary/raises, equipment, travel, materials and supplies, subawards, indirect costs, and fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain general considerations (project duration, staffing levels, geographic salary differentials), percent effort for named personnel (e.g., 'PI will allocate 25% of his time'), basis for fringe benefits (e.g., 'Fringe Benefits: Based on current payroll data, Fringe Benefits amount to 25% of Base Salary Costs'), salary escalation assumptions (e.g., 3% annual increase), subcontract justification (e.g., animal studies require BSL-2 and 'BSL-3 enhanced' facilities), equipment maintenance/replacement needs, travel purpose (conference attendance, meetings), and breakdown of material/supply costs by year. Note the form instruction 'Only attach one file.' Ensure the justification supports line-item amounts and totals in the budget.
